map.name: Tor Vessa
map.setting: a frozen fort on a mountain pass
map.trouble: Grisla the Frost Witch and her Undead have taken the Kesh Tower at the top of the pass, and the pass is closed.

guard_bark.specifics: Brask, guard at the main gate of Tor Vessa, proud of the fort and Lord Kessick.

first.speaker: Brask
first.text: Welcome to Tor Vessa, stranger! No army has ever taken this fort, and none ever will while Lord Kessick holds the pass!

again.speaker: Brask
again.text: Hmmm. Those boots won't last a week in this snow.

later.speaker: Brask
later.text: My mother wants me to come home and keep goats. Maybe I will.

bounty_offer.specifics: Dobb, the fort's quartermaster, wants the White Wolves in the meat cellar killed and hands over the cellar key.

offer.speaker: Dobb
offer.text:
Ruined! Half the winter's meat, ruined! White Wolves got into the cellar under the kitchen and they won't come out! They bit my cook!

Here, take this key. Get down there and kill every last one of them. And lock the door behind you!

reminder.speaker: Dobb
reminder.text: Those mangy wolves are eating us out of house and home!

completion.speaker: Dobb
completion.text: Ha! That'll teach 'em! Here, this shield is yours. Now go see Lord Kessick, he's got bigger troubles than wolves.

journal.text: Kill the White Wolves in the cellar for Dobb.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Steward Ormund wants the Amulet of Kesh back from the Imps' nest on the crags; he pays with a pass through the Upper Gate.

offer.speaker: Steward Ormund
offer.text: Ah! A capable soul, at last! A grievous crime has been committed against this fort. The Imps have stolen the Amulet of Kesh from my very chambers and carried it off to their nest on the crags north of here! Return it, and I shall grant you passage through the Upper Gate. Will you undertake this task?

refusal.speaker: Steward Ormund
refusal.text: Then the Upper Gate shall remain closed to you. Good day.

reminder.speaker: Steward Ormund
reminder.text: Oh.... You do not have it. Please, make haste!

completion.speaker: Steward Ormund
completion.text: The Amulet of Kesh! Returned at last! Tor Vessa is in your debt. Here is your pass for the Upper Gate. Show it to the guards and they will let you through.

after.speaker: Steward Ormund
after.text: Thanks again, brave Adventurer. Tor Vessa will not forget you.

journal.text: Recover the Amulet of Kesh from the Imps' nest.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Amulet of Kesh from the Imps' nest.

rumour.specifics: Ilsa teases, Olm brushes the player off, Petrik states the trouble plainly.

rumour1.speaker: Ilsa
rumour1.text: Ooh! Are all the men down south as big as you?

rumour3.speaker: Petrik
rumour3.text: The dead walk on the pass at night. Grisla the Frost Witch calls them up out of the snow.

shop_greeting.specifics: Rudd of the Frozen Boot inn, Haskel the smith, Brunna who sells potions and makes coffins.

inn.speaker: Rudd
inn.text: Welcome to the Frozen Boot! Warm yer bones by the fire, lad. The ale's colder'n a dead Troll's toes!

arms.speaker: Haskel
arms.text: What? You want a blade, buy a blade. I don't have all day.

magic.speaker: Brunna
magic.text: Greetings, stranger. Potions and spell books are on the shelf. If you need a coffin, I make those too. Lots of folks do this winter.

two_givers.specifics: Master Vellis bargains a spell for the Skull of Varl before Grisla gets it; Fitch sells a used Longsword cheap in the Frozen Boot.

offer_a.speaker: Master Vellis
offer_a.text: Hold, stranger! You are the one Marshal Tobrin sent, yes? Then hear me. Grisla the Frost Witch seeks the Skull of Varl, which lies in the crypt below the fort, and if she gets her hands on it every dead man on this mountain will rise and march on Tor Vessa and not one of us will live to see the spring! Bring me the Skull before she does, and I will teach you to Turn Undead. That is my bargain.

offer_b.speaker: Fitch
offer_b.text: Hey, friend! Yes, you! Need a Longsword for the road? Barely used and still sharp! Only 60 gold. Haskel would charge you twice that.

outcome_a.speaker: Master Vellis
outcome_a.text:
The Skull of Varl! You have done it! Grisla shall not have it now. As I promised, I will teach you to Turn Undead.

Now go to Lord Kessick in the Great Hall. He must hear of this at once!

outcome_b.speaker: Fitch
outcome_b.text: Sold! Best deal on the mountain, friend. Come back anytime.

journal_a.text: Bring the Skull of Varl from the crypt to Master Vellis.

journal_b.text: Buy the Longsword from Fitch at the Frozen Boot.

rescue.specifics: Wilda begs the player to bring home her husband Fennick, the winch-maker, trapped by the Undead in the mine east of the fort.

plea.speaker: Wilda
plea.text: Greetings, kind sir! Oh, thank goodness, please you have to help me, my husband Fennick went up to the mine east of here to fix the winch and the Undead came down off the pass and now he's trapped in there and nobody will go up after him because they're all too scared and Lord Kessick says he can't spare a single man! If you bring Fennick home to me, I'll give you anything I have!

reminder.speaker: Wilda
reminder.text: Please hurry! He's been up there so long!

found.speaker: Fennick
found.text: Hello? Is somebody there? Get me out of here, please!

following.speaker: Fennick
following.text: The lift at the back of the mine still works. I just fixed it! Pull the lever and it'll take us down.

completion.speaker: Wilda
completion.text: Fennick! You brought him home! Thank you, thank you, kind sir! Please, take this spell book. It's full of weather spells. I can't make heads or tails of it.

journal.text: Rescue Fennick from the mine and bring him home to Wilda.

main_opening.specifics: Dobb points the newcomer to Lord Kessick, who tells of the Kesh Tower's fall to Grisla's Undead and sends the player up the pass with gold and potions.

herald.speaker: Dobb
herald.text: You came up the pass alone?! Lord Kessick's been waiting on you. Great Hall, top of the stairs.

opening.speaker: Lord Kessick
opening.text:
So Marshal Tobrin sent you. Then you come at a black hour, lad. Last night the Kesh Tower fell. Grisla the Frost Witch came down out of the storm with an army of the Undead behind her, and my men in the tower fought until the last torch went out and then they rose up again and turned their swords on their own brothers and now they serve her!

The pass is closed. All the north is in peril while that wicked witch holds the Kesh Tower!

Take this gold and these potions, and get restocked in town. Then go up to the Kesh Tower and destroy Grisla the Frost Witch. Go now, and may all that is great protect you!

reminder.speaker: Lord Kessick
reminder.text: Why do you linger, lad? The Frost Witch grows stronger every night!

journal.text: Go up to the Kesh Tower and destroy Grisla the Frost Witch.
